# Generate e2e — strict verify success (network disclosure includes govulncheck).

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent-strict
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent-strict

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-strict/minimal-cli --verify strict --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
stdout 'go-mod-tidy'
stdout 'go-govulncheck'
! stderr .
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-strict/minimal-cli/go.mod
